clips.title: The story
paras: Across the Barrens, Sample Snapjaw Shells carry lingering vitality from freshwater oases. Tauren druids send them across the Great Sea to help heal Silverpine Forest.

Snapjaws thrive in the lush, strange oases of the Barrens. Their durable shells keep a faint inner glow and pulse with energy long after separation from the creature. Tauren druids watching the land's swift changes see in these carapaces the resilient spark of Kalimdor's wilderness. Their vigor shows how life can flourish even in harsh, arid surroundings.

Tauren naturalists send couriers across the sea with shells for Mura Runetotem at the Sepulcher. Stationed in Silverpine Forest's blighted expanses, Mura seeks ways to help the Forsaken heal the northlands. She studies the life-force preserved in the snapjaw's armor, hoping to find what can renew an ailing forest and bring growth back to dying soil.
